mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID AS memberId, MEMBER_NM AS memberNm, BIRTH_DATE AS birthDate, PHONE AS phone, EMAIL AS email, MEMBER_STATUS AS memberStatus, JOIN_DATE AS joinDate FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET MEMBER_STATUS = #{memberStatus} WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
